svg.title: Three polar curves: a cardioid, a limaçon with an inner loop and a rose
svg.desc: Three polar graphs, each drawn from its equation. Left: the cardioid r = 2 + 2 cos θ, a heart shape that reaches 4 units right of the pole at θ = 0 and touches the pole once, at θ = π. Middle: the limaçon r = 1 + 2 cos θ, a large loop with a small inner loop, drawn in vermillion, traced while r is negative for 2π/3 < θ < 4π/3. Right: the rose r = 3 sin(2θ), four petals of length 3, one petal traced for each stretch of θ of length π/2.

text.tspan: touches the pole once, at θ = π
one petal for every π/2 of θ
